-- A name is safe when it is a plain relative path that stays inside the
-- directory: not empty, no NUL, not absolute, no backslash, no ".." segment.
safe_name(name: str) -> bool =
  ex safe_name("a.txt") == True
  ex safe_name("") == False
  ex safe_name("../secret") == False
  ex safe_name("/etc/passwd") == False
  ex safe_name("a/../../b") == False
  if name.char_count() == 0
    return False
  for c in name.chars()
    if c == "\\" or c == "\0" or c == ":"
      return False
  let parts = name.split("/")
  -- a leading "/" yields an empty first segment: absolute path
  if parts[0] == ""
    return False
  for p in parts
    if p == ".."
      return False
  True

-- Text of the first name in `names` that can be read from `notes`,
-- or "" when none can. Reads go through `fs` confined to `notes`.
first_readable(names: List[str]) -> str uses fs =
  post names.len() > 0 or out == ""
  ex first_readable([]) == ""
  ex first_readable(["../secret", "/etc/passwd"]) == ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    for n in names
      if safe_name(n)
        let t = fs.read(n) else continue
        return t
  ""
